text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(Even though I lost... Even though it's frustrating,
my heart feels so light and floaty.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (Because she really was like the wind—)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Flower-san, are you all right?
Your breathing seems quite heavy."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I'm all right.
Um, more importantly...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr-san, congratulations!
My heart is pounding so fast right now...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it...
I felt like Zephyr-san just whooshed past...
like a gust of wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. That expression...
is the highest praise I could receive.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Wanting to challenge "what lies beyond"...
Those feelings gave me strength.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...The next time we meet
will be at the Takamatsunomiya Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I have run the Mile CS to the end.
As for the next sprint race..."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Stronger, fiercer... I shall become a raging storm.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (...I wonder what Zephyr-san is aiming for?)
